name: Kerveros
blurb: Kerveros is a robust, cross-platform two-factor authentication (2FA) code generator that combines enterprise-grade security with user-friendly features.
description:
Kerveros is a robust, cross-platform two-factor authentication (2FA) code generator that combines enterprise-grade security with user-friendly features. Generate time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) for all your online accounts while keeping your secrets encrypted and protected.

Key Features:

• Master Password Protection: SHA-256 hashing with salting for enhanced security

• Encrypted Secret Storage: XOR encryption with initialization vectors

• TOTP Code Generation: RFC-compliant time-based one-time passwords

• Real-time Code Updates: Automatic refresh every 30 seconds with visual countdown timer

• QR Code Import: Drag and drop or file menu import of QR code images

• One-Click Copy: Instant clipboard copy with visual feedback

• Password Attempt Limiting: 5 attempts before factory reset option

• System Tray Integration: Minimize to tray with quick restore

• Export/Import Functionality: Full backup and restore capabilities

• Single Instance Enforcement: Prevents multiple app conflicts

Kerveros is designed for security-conscious users who need a reliable, secure, and easy-to-use 2FA code generator with master password protection for all their online accounts including GitHub, Google, PayPal, Discord, and more.
